current_evidence: The council's 'Making a planning application' page, under 'Local validation requirements', links 'Local Area Requirements List 2025 Final.pdf'. That document is titled 'Local Area Planning Application Validation Requirements List, November 2025' and describes itself as a review of the 2023 version.

issues.detail: Grokbot links the June 2023 list. It has been superseded by the November 2025 Local Area Planning Application Validation Requirements List (joint Malvern Hills / Wychavon), which the council's 'Making a planning application' page now links. The 2025 review says there are no significant content changes, but it updates NPPF references, adds the Schedule 7A BNG reference and tweaks triggers (e.g. Agricultural Land Assessment now includes loss of 2ha+ BMV land; HIA now lists employment 5ha+ and retail 500sqm+). The council's 'Planning application forms' page still links an older 'Local Area Requirements List Merged 2021' PDF, so the council's own links are inconsistent.
issues.evidence: Making a planning application page: 'pdf Local Requirements List (754 KB)' -> Local Area Requirements List 2025 Final.pdf; document: 'November 2025 ... review of the 2023 version'

issues.detail: The List date 2023-09-01 comes from PDF metadata (CreationDate). The document text dates it June 2023. The current list is dated November 2025.
issues.evidence: 2023 PDF text: 'Local Area Planning Application Validation Requirements List, June 2023'

issues.detail: The list is a joint Malvern Hills and Wychavon document, but the reference row records 'Joint / shared list' as null and 'council-specific (no shared list identified)'.
issues.evidence: Document covers 'Malvern Hills District Council and Wychavon District Council'

issues.detail: Several local requirements are not captured. Existing Employment Sites re-development/change of use assessment: loss of B1/B2/B8 of 1,000sqm+ net in urban areas, or rural employment/tourism/leisure premises. Glint and Glare Assessment: large-scale solar farms. Replacement Rural Dwellings Statement: demolition/replacement of a dwelling in open countryside. Rural Workers' Dwelling Justification: Grokbot's row has the Agricultural Land Assessment text instead. Ventilation/Extraction Statement: new restaurants, takeaways and pubs/bars selling hot food next to residential property. Water Management Statement: all applications resulting in waste or surface water to be drained. Retail and Centres Impact Assessment: only present mislabelled as a flood sequential test. CIL Assumption of Liability Form: all CIL-liable applications.
issues.evidence: 2023 list items 10, 13, 23, 25, 31, 33, 24, 35 (e.g. Water Management Statement: 'all applications that result in waste or surface water to be drained')

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none)', but several general triggers apply to householder proposals. These include the Arboricultural Statement (trees/hedges on site), Heritage Statement ('any planning application ... which affects the significance of a heritage asset'), FRA (development in Flood Zones 2/3), Ecological information (likely impact on protected species), Daylight/Sunlight (adverse impact on neighbours), Water Management Statement (all applications draining surface/waste water) and the CIL form where CIL-liable. LVIA is the only item that expressly excludes householder development.
issues.evidence: Heritage Statement - When required: 'Any planning application or application seeking listed building consent which affects the significance...'; LVIA: 'development other than householder development in Areas of Outstanding Natural Beauty'

issues.detail: Almost all rows (about 28) are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', and Outline and Reserved matters are both '(none)'. The list is general, with triggers based on development type, size and location. The Energy Statement explicitly addresses outline (broad terms) and reserved matters (detailed evidence). The Heritage Statement is filed only under Listed building consent even though it applies to any planning application affecting a heritage asset. Telecoms is filed only under prior approval although it applies to all telecoms applications.
issues.evidence: Energy Statement guidance distinguishing outline and full/reserved matters; Telecoms: 'All applications proposing telecommunications development, including applications for prior approval'

issues.detail: The 'Change of Use of Rural Buildings - Marketing Report' is placed under 'Change of use - prior approval'. Under SWDP12/Annex F it is required with planning applications to convert rural employment/tourism buildings to non-employment use, not with prior approvals. The Structural Survey is also placed there, though its trigger relates to LBC/demolition and the conversion of rural buildings by planning application.
issues.evidence: 'Change of Use of Rural Buildings - Marketing Report ... SWDP12 and Annex F ... For applications proposing the conversion of a rural building last used for B1, B2, B8...'

issues.detail: Several rows carry text from a different requirement. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' holds the Retail and Centres Impact Assessment text (retail/leisure over 1,000sqm). 'Schedule of works (listed building)' holds Arboricultural Method Statement text; the source has no separate schedule-of-works item. 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' holds the Agricultural Land Classification text, identical to the next row. 'CIL Additional Information / Form' holds the Planning Obligations/Heads of Terms text. 'Floor plans / Elevations' holds the Street-scene Elevations text, duplicating that row. 'Design and Access Statement' and 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' both hold an introductory sentence about CIL.
issues.evidence: Grokbot 'Schedule of works' trigger: '(i) Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS) - sets out the information regarding the measures to be taken to protect the trees'

issues.detail: Some triggers are fragments or lose the thresholds. Flood Risk Assessment ('will depend on the size, type and location') omits 1ha+ in Flood Zone 1 and all development in Zones 2/3. Viability is just 'reasoning (eg. a Viability Assessment). 10.'. Affordable Housing omits the key local trigger of even a single new dwelling in a Designated Rural Area. Travel Plan repeats the Transport Assessment text instead of its own trigger (10+ dwellings or more than 1,000sqm non-residential). Foul Sewage omits the major-development threshold (10+ houses / 1,000sqm+).
issues.evidence: FRA: '1 hectares or greater in flood zone 1' (plus Zones 2 and 3); Travel Plan: '10 or more dwellings or more than 1,000 sq metres of non residential'; Affordable Housing: 'at least a single new dwelling in a Designated Rural Area'

issues.detail: The 'Submission rules' tab item is a garbled set of CIL charging-schedule URL fragments ('CIL Charging Structure (malvernhills.gov.uk) 2017 and Reg 23 123 Final Verison - MHDC.pdf ...'), not a requirement statement.
issues.evidence: Tab item text as captured by Grokbot

summary: Grokbot captured the June 2023 Malvern Hills/Wychavon list (mis-dated from PDF metadata). It has since been replaced by the November 2025 version linked from the council's 'Making a planning application' page. Within the 2023 extraction, about eight requirements are missing (Glint and Glare, Water Management, Ventilation, Replacement Rural Dwellings, Employment Sites and others), several rows carry another requirement's text, and Householder/Outline are wrongly marked as having no local requirements.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
